nodes.label: Scalable Cluster Termination System (S-CTS)
nodes.rationale: System designed to identify and terminate coordinated account clusters exhibiting a prevalence of synthetic/adversarial AI-generated content, moving defense from isolated content evaluation to systemic account-relatedness and behavioral clustering.

nodes.label: Classifier ΨA: Coordinated Bot-Net Detection (Account Relatedness)
nodes.rationale: Uses internal Google infrastructure signals (API usage patterns, event time series, GenAI-specific metadata) to cluster accounts likely controlled by the same actor or automated generation script, reducing compute cost per decision vs. individual video scans.
nodes.norm_label: classifier ψa: coordinated bot-net detection (account relatedness)

nodes.label: Classifier ΨC: Synthetic Content & Slop Prevalence
nodes.rationale: Scores content against Content Integrity benchmarks using textual and multimedia analysis to produce content-level synthetic classification tags.
nodes.norm_label: classifier ψc: synthetic content & slop prevalence

nodes.label: Synthetic Content Rater (Two-Stage LLM Architecture)
nodes.rationale: Engineering enhancement to ΨC designed to manage high dimensionality of video data by transforming raw multimodal signals into actionable textual context before final classification.

nodes.label: Stage 1: Multimodal Context Distillation (Feature Extraction)
nodes.rationale: Processes raw video frames, audio, transcripts using multimodal semantic embeddings and temporal behavioral signals (video text embeddings, salient terms, upload pacing, Pulsar visual embeddings) rather than pixel-level forensics, producing a compact integrity-aware textual summary.

nodes.label: Stage 2: Channel-level Classifier
nodes.rationale: Makes the final determination via semantic reasoning over synthesized textual context summaries rather than raw video pixels.

nodes.label: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)
nodes.rationale: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique reducing trainable parameters and memory footprint, enabling rapid retraining of adapters when new generative models emerge.

nodes.label: Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO)
nodes.rationale: Allows prompt engineering to adapt to new 'Slop' trends faster than retraining a dense model.
